PSG-shaped simulation validation supplement

Source: vignettes/psg-validation-supplement.Rmd
psg-validation-supplement.Rmd

Design

data-raw/psg-validation-simulations.R simulates high-frequency recurrent gap records with participant frailty, visit effects, and persistent burst/recovery states. It therefore has clustered bouts and unequal event counts. Recording duration is 360–480 minutes; its final incomplete gap is terminally censored. Independent-arm scenarios use unequal groups (30 control, 45 treatment), while paired-visit scenarios share participant frailty across the two labels.

The null has equal gap distributions. Longer and shorter treatment-bout alternatives multiply treatment gaps by 1.25 and 0.80. The output evaluates Luo–Huang Gρ*G_\rho^* at ρ=0\rho=0 and ρ=1\rho=1, Zhao pooled-risk sensitivity analyses, and the paired within-person label-permutation procedure. The paired Zhao row is explicitly an unpaired sensitivity analysis; the permutation test is the randomization-valid paired analysis.

Producing the table and figure 

Sys.setenv(RUN_PSG_VALIDATION = "true", PSG_N_SIM = "1000", PSG_B = "999")
source("data-raw/psg-validation-simulations.R")

result <- readRDS("data-raw/psg-validation-results.rds")
knitr::kable(result, digits = 3)
knitr::include_graphics("data-raw/psg-validation-rejection-rates.png")

At a 0.05 threshold, null rows estimate type-I error and alternative rows estimate power. Monte-Carlo standard errors are written with the table.
